sections.heading: Identity and current status
sections.body:
- Project ID: `github-copilot`
- Canonical name: GitHub Copilot (`claim-github-copilot-sf-identity`; existing canonical `claim-github-copilot-identity` is not reused)
- Vendor: GitHub (`claim-github-copilot-sf-vendor`)
- Canonical URL: https://github.com/features/copilot/ (`claim-github-copilot-sf-canonical-url`)
- Current status: public Free through Enterprise plans (`claim-github-copilot-sf-status`)
- Last source-backed identity check: 2026-08-15
- CLI latest labeled 1.0.80 on 2026-08-14 (`claim-github-copilot-sf-version-cli`, `claim-github-copilot-sf-maintenance`)
- Public CLI repository: https://github.com/github/copilot-cli (`claim-github-copilot-sf-repository-url`). Family source for the IDE, app, and cloud agent: unknown

sections.heading: What it is and is not
sections.body:
- What it is: a GitHub-native AI coding assistant family spanning GitHub, IDEs, CLI, project tools, chat apps, MCP, and a desktop app (`claim-github-copilot-sf-identity`, `claim-github-copilot-sf-what-it-is`). The CLI uses the same agentic harness as Copilot coding agent (`claim-github-copilot-sf-cli-harness`)
- What it is not: not available on GitHub Enterprise Server (`claim-github-copilot-sf-not-ghes`). Copilot cloud agent is not IDE agent mode (`claim-github-copilot-sf-not-ide-agent-mode`). The desktop app is not a generic IDE (`claim-github-copilot-sf-surface-app`). GitHub Desktop commit-message Copilot is not the Copilot desktop app (`claim-github-copilot-sf-surface-github-desktop`)

sections.heading: Architecture and agent-loop ownership
sections.body:
- Primary type: labeled proposal `runtime` (`claim-github-copilot-sf-primary-type`). This is an inference, not a first-party noun
- Secondary roles: `ide` (`claim-github-copilot-sf-secondary-role-ide`); `cloud-agent` (`claim-github-copilot-sf-secondary-role-cloud-agent`)
- Agent-loop owner: Copilot CLI/agent owns tools, plan mode, approvals, MCP, custom agents, hooks, and skills on the CLI surface (`claim-github-copilot-sf-agent-loop`). Cloud agent owns the loop inside a GitHub Actions environment (`claim-github-copilot-sf-execution-cloud-agent`)
- Architecture: desktop app is built on Copilot CLI (`claim-github-copilot-sf-architecture-app`). CLI and coding agent share an agentic harness (`claim-github-copilot-sf-cli-harness`)

sections.heading: Surfaces and execution location
sections.body:
- Surface IDs: `surface-github-copilot-cli`, `surface-github-copilot-app`, `surface-github-copilot-ide`, `surface-github-copilot-github-desktop`, `surface-github-copilot-windows-terminal`, `surface-github-copilot-raycast`, `surface-github-copilot-web`, `surface-github-copilot-mobile`, `surface-github-copilot-cloud-agent`, `surface-github-copilot-cli-cloud-sandbox`, `surface-github-copilot-cli-remote-web`, `surface-github-copilot-cli-remote-mobile`, `surface-github-copilot-cli-remote-relay`, `surface-github-copilot-slack`, `surface-github-copilot-teams`, `surface-github-copilot-project-tools`, `surface-github-copilot-acp`
- Execution location: same-device for default CLI (`claim-github-copilot-sf-execution-local`); vendor-cloud Actions VMs for cloud agent (`claim-github-copilot-sf-execution-cloud-agent`); vendor-cloud Linux sandboxes for `copilot --cloud` (`claim-github-copilot-sf-execution-cloud-sandbox`)

sections.heading: Model/auth/provider strategy
sections.body:
- Model strategy: docs plans say hosted multi-model catalog; Free/Student use auto selection only (`claim-github-copilot-sf-model-strategy`). Marketing plans say chat, agent mode, review, cloud agent, CLI, and apps consume AI credits (`claim-github-copilot-sf-model-credits`). CLI README defaults to Claude Sonnet 4.5 (`claim-github-copilot-sf-model-cli-default`)
- Auth strategy: GitHub `/login` or a Copilot Requests PAT (`claim-github-copilot-sf-auth-strategy`)
- Provider support: marketing catalog names Anthropic, OpenAI, Microsoft, Google, xAI, and Kimi (`claim-github-copilot-sf-provider-support`). CLI can use a custom OpenAI-compatible, Azure, Anthropic, or local Ollama endpoint (`claim-github-copilot-sf-byok`)
- First-party local-model runtime beyond CLI custom providers: unknown (`claim-github-copilot-sf-byok`)

sections.heading: Context, memory, compaction, and session behavior
sections.body:
- Context behavior: optional 1M window on supported CLI models (`claim-github-copilot-sf-context`)
- Memory: Copilot Memory public preview for repository facts and user preferences (`claim-github-copilot-sf-memory`). Custom instructions are a separate customization path (`claim-github-copilot-sf-orchestration-cloud-agent`)
- Compaction: CLI auto-compact at 95% plus `/compact` (`claim-github-copilot-sf-compaction`)
- Session behavior: account-synced view-only history and CLI resume (`claim-github-copilot-sf-session`). Optional cloud-sandbox snapshots (`claim-github-copilot-sf-session-cloud-sandbox`)

sections.heading: Tools, extensions, MCP, skills, hooks, and APIs
sections.body:
- Tools: file, shell, git, gh, and GitHub.com task tools with approval (`claim-github-copilot-sf-tools`)
- Extensions: unknown as a first-party marketplace product. CLI changelog mentions plugins; that depth was not inventoried
- MCP: client across IDE, CLI, app, and cloud agent; GitHub MCP ships with CLI (`claim-github-copilot-sf-mcp`)
- Skills: Agent Skills on cloud agent, code review, CLI, app, and VS Code/JetBrains agent mode (`claim-github-copilot-sf-skills`)
- Hooks: JSON hooks for cloud agent and CLI (`claim-github-copilot-sf-hooks`)
- APIs: CLI ACP server (`claim-github-copilot-sf-api`, `claim-github-copilot-sf-surface-acp`). `@github/copilot-sdk` talks to the CLI over JSON-RPC and is the sibling candidate `github-copilot-sdk` (`claim-github-copilot-sf-api-sdk`). Do not merge ids

sections.heading: Orchestration and parallelism
sections.body:
- Orchestration: CLI custom agents with automatic task delegation (`claim-github-copilot-sf-orchestration`). Cloud-agent custom agents plus repository/org custom instructions (`claim-github-copilot-sf-orchestration-cloud-agent`)
- Parallelism: parallel desktop-app sessions (`claim-github-copilot-sf-parallelism`). Parallel cloud-sandbox CLI tasks (`claim-github-copilot-sf-parallelism-cloud-sandbox`). Cloud agent is one branch and one PR per assigned task (`claim-github-copilot-sf-drawback`)

sections.heading: Isolation, permissions, security, and data path
sections.body:
- Isolation: optional experimental local OS sandbox (`claim-github-copilot-sf-isolation-local`); cloud-sandbox CLI sessions (`claim-github-copilot-sf-execution-cloud-sandbox`); ephemeral Actions environments with a 59-minute cap (`claim-github-copilot-sf-isolation-cloud-agent`)
- Permissions: per-tool approval, allow/deny flags, trusted directories (`claim-github-copilot-sf-permissions`)
- Security: docs features list org/enterprise policies, access, usage data, audit logs, and file exclusions (`claim-github-copilot-sf-security`). Marketing plans mark enterprise-grade security, IP indemnity, and SAML SSO as not included on individual plans (`claim-github-copilot-sf-security-marketing`)
- Data path: no Business/Enterprise training; individual training unless opt-out; 28-day retention outside IDE chat/completions (`claim-github-copilot-sf-data-path`)

sections.heading: Pricing, license, maintenance, and lock-in
sections.body:
- Pricing: docs plans list Free; Student free; Pro $10; Pro+ $39; Max $100; Business $19/seat; Enterprise $39/seat (`claim-github-copilot-sf-pricing-docs`). Credits are $0.01 each with Pro $15 / Pro+ $70 / Max $200 monthly totals (`claim-github-copilot-sf-pricing-credits`)
- License: proprietary Copilot CLI license plus GitHub Copilot service terms (`claim-github-copilot-sf-license`)
- Maintenance: CLI changelog through 1.0.80 on 2026-08-14 (`claim-github-copilot-sf-maintenance`)
- Lock-in related facts: GitHub account and Copilot subscription required (`claim-github-copilot-sf-auth-strategy`); cloud agent works only on GitHub-hosted repositories (`claim-github-copilot-sf-drawback`); individual data may be used for training unless opted out (`claim-github-copilot-sf-data-path`)

sections.heading: Lineage and compatibility edges
sections.body:
- Lineage claims: CLI shares the coding-agent harness (`claim-github-copilot-sf-cli-harness`); desktop app is built on the CLI (`claim-github-copilot-sf-architecture-app`)
- Relationship edges: none restaged. `github-copilot-sdk` is a distinct candidate that official pages say talks to Copilot CLI over JSON-RPC (`claim-github-copilot-sf-api-sdk`). No directed staging tuple was added
- Compatibility: ACP clients can host Copilot CLI (`claim-github-copilot-sf-surface-acp`). Third-party coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) can be delegated from some Copilot plans (`claim-github-copilot-sf-third-party-agents-pro-card`, `claim-github-copilot-sf-third-party-agents-pro-compare`, `claim-github-copilot-sf-third-party-agents-docs-pro`)

sections.heading: Unique edge, meaningful drawbacks, best fit, and not-for
sections.body:
- Unique edge: vendor positioning as natively built into GitHub (`claim-github-copilot-sf-unique`)
- Meaningful drawbacks: cloud-agent single-repo / GitHub-hosted-only / 59-minute cap (`claim-github-copilot-sf-drawback`); not on GHES (`claim-github-copilot-sf-not-ghes`); individual training unless opt-out (`claim-github-copilot-sf-data-path`); third-party-agent plan lists conflict (`claim-github-copilot-sf-third-party-agents-pro-card`, `claim-github-copilot-sf-third-party-agents-pro-compare`, `claim-github-copilot-sf-third-party-agents-docs-pro`)
- Best fit: documented audiences are individuals, students, organizations, and enterprises (`claim-github-copilot-sf-intended-user`). This is not a recommendation
- Not-for: GHES (`claim-github-copilot-sf-not-ghes`); Free excludes cloud agent (`claim-github-copilot-sf-not-for-free`); Free FAQ caps (`claim-github-copilot-sf-not-for-free-faq`); users who need IDE agent mode rather than cloud agent (`claim-github-copilot-sf-not-ide-agent-mode`)
